redundant_work.problem: Python adjacency traversal duplicates graph traversal for offline evaluation
redundant_work.impact: Valid for baseline/control, but must not be presented as the live HydraDB path
redundant_work.minimal_correction: Label it explicitly as offline reference/control and keep live compiler HydraDB-only

redundant_work.problem: Legacy standalone MERGE statement generator remains alongside the batch writer
redundant_work.impact: Future callers can accidentally use mutation forms that fail on the deployed dialect
redundant_work.minimal_correction: Remove or mark deprecated and route all document ingestion through write_graph

redundant_work.problem: Legacy standalone mutation generator remains alongside graph_for_artifacts/write_graph
redundant_work.impact: Same risk of unsupported writes and divergent behavior
redundant_work.minimal_correction: Remove/deprecate and test only the shared writer

p0_gaps.problem: Live HydraDB ingestion still needs verification against the active write-capable node
p0_gaps.minimal_fix: Run a clean DataFusion node and validate the explicit UNWIND parameter dialect with a minimal node, edge, and readback test before fixture ingestion
p0_gaps.acceptance_test: Two ingestion runs pass; node/edge counts and properties remain stable; failed writes exit non-zero

p0_gaps.problem: One packet is assembled from multiple independent HTTP snapshots
p0_gaps.minimal_fix: Use a causal bookmark/read epoch when HydraDB supports it; otherwise explicitly label packets non-atomic
p0_gaps.acceptance_test: All recipe responses used by one packet share a verified epoch/bookmark

p0_gaps.problem: Requirement coverage needed to be represented in packets
p0_gaps.minimal_fix: Implemented typed requirement IDs, covered/missing IDs, and complete-coverage gating for supported
p0_gaps.acceptance_test: Removing owner or mitigation evidence yields mixed/insufficient, never supported

p0_gaps.problem: Aliases, ambiguity, and unresolved entities needed explicit states
p0_gaps.minimal_fix: Implemented explicit resolution state records and no random name selection
p0_gaps.acceptance_test: checkout-api, Payments Platform, and unknown-entity produce explicit resolution states

p1_gaps.problem: No structured competing-owner, temporal, rollback, or candidate contradiction model
Claims lack source IDs and read epoch; paths are not validated
Groq errors are swallowed before OpenCode fallback
Live Cypher recipes do not expose explicit max result/hop/runtime controls in the client
Unused legacy statement generators can drift from the supported writer
